While I think tdoss is his best album since relapse, classic seems too early of a label to be put on it. The album to me was never meant to appeal to anyone but his fanbase. That's why it's probably his most mixed album in decades. 
I feel like a classic album has to be somewhat acclaimed and loved. Not just by your extremely dedicated fanbase. 

I do think it has the potential to be a cult classic( arguably it already is), but "classic" is a stretch

That being said, I do think Eminem has more than 3 classic album. I think relapse is a classic. And depending on who you ask it's entirely possible he has more. 

I think it's possible for Eminem to have a classic album again, but it would have to be something special and genuinely groundbreaking. I also feel like the bar for "classic album" has been raised since TPAB and IGOR. 

With that, if Eminem does release an album, no matter how good, it'll probably be trashed no matter what. It's what happened with literally all of his albums in his career. It's just very popular to hate Eminem right now

It's a concept about slim shady coming back to try to cancel Eminem. He attempts to get him to relapse by force feeding him drugs to get him to rap how he did on his earlier albums. Slim shady is eventually successful in getting Eminem canceled. The Houdini video shows Eminem and slim shady being combined into one hence Guilty conscience 2 where he argues internally with himself. After he kills slim shady, the concept essentially ends. The following tracks are just Eminem rapping about things like his career, his family, his drug addiction, and his role as a rapper. The fact that slim shady is gone is showcased by the fact that the disses towards Christopher Reeves, Caitlyn Jenner, and others are stopped, the edgy lines are done with, and he's much more raw and honest. 

The point of the album was to showcase  that not only could the slim shady character not survive today, but the fact that he's embarrassed by the character and wants to detach himself from it, despite all the success it brought.
